text: We should readily excuse our friends when their faults are born with them, and they are less than their good qualities... We should try to make them perceive their faults, so as to give them the merit of correcting them.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld
reference: Reflections; or Sentences and Moral Maxims
translation: J. W. Willis Bund and J. Hain Friswell, 1871
